versions.changelog:
- Initial release with support for online car hailing itinerary receipt OCR recognition.
- Requires SCNET_API_KEY for authentication; supports optional API base URL override.
- Accepts local image file paths (jpg/png/pdf, etc.) and outputs structured JSON results.
- Detailed usage instructions, environment variable setup, and troubleshooting info included.
- Includes rate limiting guidance and error handling suggestions for stable usage.
